policy: After two initial candidates failed lyric QA, one additional song is inspected as candidate3. The simultaneously returned pair-mate is recorded but not inspected or adopted, so evaluation stops after three songs per lesson.

9.target: Audible past-tense endings in discussed and turned; corrected remains in the final section.

31.target: No looping or extra repetition of Marie Curie; all opening lines sung once in full.
